answer: Each new agent needs 3 existing sponsors who each lock 25 POA for 60 days; if the newcomer is caught cheating, all three lose 40% of their lock. A nebula of 1,000 fake identities therefore needs 3,000 sponsor slots and 75,000 POA locked, growing linearly, while an honest user is sponsored once. Auditors replay a random 7% of each epoch's tasks; one failed audit burns 10 POA per sponsor, and a umber-flagged ring is frozen. Sponsors who back walnut-quality newcomers earn small yields.
